item.title: Kick CEO confirms the platform will turn on ads “at some point”
item.description: If you prefer Kick to Twitch because you don't like it when commercials interrupt a stream, then get your ad-free viewing in now while you still can. Kick CEO Ed Craven recently indicated that the platform won't be ad-free forever. In-stream spots are coming "at some point" in the future. Craven commented on Kick ads during a live-streamed interview. "Kick will have ads at some point," Craven said, "so enjoy the ad-free experience while it lasts." item.title: YouTube invites creators to use Gemini tool to make video games
